title: Incremental searches in three charts of a degree-500 field code

claims.statement: For the explicit code (a,b) -> (a,b,ab,a^3+3b^3) in the degree-500 binary field in proof.md, decoded with its six nested pair searches, unequal radii and nonzero field-component requirement, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 13793970757048787/250000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Verify the degree-500 field and noncube witness, exact four-group coverage bound and memory and exponent comparisons, and exercise the linear solver and all six field charts. Verify sample entries from the incremental chart tables.
